subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `deferred` as a public cron run status and the new parent-lifecycle callback/helpers as plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The underlying bug needs repair, but this PR also selects new persisted, protocol, CLI/UI, hook, and external plugin contracts that correctness review cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept the public lifecycle contract
options.body: Keep `deferred` and the SDK/hook additions after the blockers are repaired and compatibility, upgrade, and live behavior are proven.

options.title: Keep lifecycle state internal
options.body: Fix cron and Discord settlement using internal lifecycle state without adding permanent public status and SDK contracts.

options.title: Split the broad change
options.body: Land narrower runtime repairs first and design the public lifecycle contract in a separate sponsored change.

recommendation.title: Accept the public lifecycle contract
recommendation.body: Keep `deferred` and the SDK/hook additions after the blockers are repaired and compatibility, upgrade, and live behavior are proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans the subagent lifecycle, Discord reaction, and approval-manager boundaries, making them the strongest available owner for the cross-surface contract decision.
